overrides.value: Downloads PDFs for selected items in batches from sources such as Unpaywall, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, Sci-Hub mirrors, and a configured institutional proxy, resolves publisher landing pages to the actual PDF, and retries failed or login-blocked items.
